To: Derrick Carson <dcarson @tylersbestauto.ca> tail
From: Alexander Marquez <amarquez @ appdeveloper.ca>
Subject: New mobile app
Date: 2 February jo}
t
Dear Derrick,
We have finally completed work on the new mobile app that will allow your customers
to shop for vehicles and make service appointments using any type of wireless device.
As you know, it took us longer than originally expected to develop an app that would
work on different types of devices. Unfortunately, the first round of testing revealed
some significant flaws. However, we have made significant progress since then. We can
now guarantee that the software works correctly.
Per your instructions, there will be a special service discount coupon available only
through the app. Hopefully, the coupon will encourage customers to use the app.
Sincerely,
Alexander
